run_read_tty_cli: run the read_tty script to replay a ttyrec file with colored terminal output
run_read_tty_stdin: run the read_tty script piping ttyrec data via stdin using the dash filename argument
run_read_tty_frame_range: run the read_tty script with start and end flags to replay a specific frame range
run_read_tty_no_pager: run the read_tty script with the no_pager flag to disable piping output to less
run_read_tty_no_input: run the read_tty script with the no_input flag to parse legacy ttyrec format without input data
